'''Nick Smarcz''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Rochester tournament (30 September)]] on 30 September 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court deck]], according to Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1284">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-01-rochester-ny-9-30-00-part-i-of-iid1284/ rochester-ny-9-30-00-part-i-of-ii], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 1 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-01-rochester-ny-9-30-00-part-i-of-iid1284/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
